effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait or [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]) from your hand without paying the cost.
